newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee eases vs spot dlr, forwards volatile.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee eases vs spot dlr, forwards volatile.

text.p: India's spot rupee eased to 35.83 against the dollar from 35.82 on Thursday after the State Bank of India (SBI) bought dollars, dealers said.
The rupee opened the day at 35.82/83 but soon reverted to 35.81/82 at which it had been stuck for over a week.
Spot dollar was quoted at 35.82/83 in latest deals.
The forward dollar market was volatile on the impact of Reserve Bank of India's bank rate and deposit rate cuts announced on Wednesday, dealers said.
December dollars moved from 60/63 paise to 70/73 paise on profit-taking. Exporters said they hoped the latest crash in premiums would be temporary.
